lines.trans: A breakup plunges you into a cold, lonely night.
But with the sunrise come new reasons to keep living.
Cuisine is a true high art.
You cannot simply copy other people's dishes.
You need a unique recipe that nobody can replicate.
And I only have simple pâté on the menu.
I must invent my own new signature dish.
Something exquisite, like beautiful France itself!
Wait, what is happening with the lights in the kitchen?
What kind of devilry is going on in here?
Could it be a real poltergeist?
It is the spirit of a dead person who came back to take revenge!
Friends, who could take revenge on us, Grandpa Kirill?

meanings.note: Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'ысканный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('exquisite / refined').

meanings.en: to happen, take place, go on
